speed.sectionDescription: Applies to every engine after synthesis. Pitch is preserved.
speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Default speed for new generations, batches and API/MCP calls.

export.sectionDescription: Defaults used when downloading audio from History and Batch.

format.title: Default file format
format.description: WAV is lossless and largest, FLAC is lossless and smaller, MP3 is smallest.

bitrate.title: MP3 bitrate
bitrate.description: Higher is better quality and a bigger file. 192 kbps suits most voice work.

loudness.title: Loudness normalization
loudness.description: Brings every generation to the same perceived loudness (EBU R128, peak capped at -1 dBFS). Applies to new generations.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation dictionary
pronunciation.description: Words, names and abbreviations are rewritten before they reach the voice engine, so they are read the way you want. History and subtitles keep your original text.

enable.title: Use the dictionary
enable.description: Turn off to read text exactly as written.

pronunciation.empty: No entries yet. Add a word, or import a CSV with two columns: written form, spoken form.
pronunciation.importHint: CSV format: one entry per line, "written,spoken" (comma, semicolon or tab). Longer entries win over shorter ones, and replacements are never re-replaced.
pronunciation.importEmpty: No entries found in that file

test.title: Try it
test.placeholder: Type a sentence to see what the engine will actually read…

vram.title: GPU memory (VRAM)
vram.description: Live usage of your graphics card and the models currently loaded.
vram.noCuda: No CUDA GPU detected — models run on the CPU, so VRAM management does not apply.

idle.title: Free voice models when idle
idle.description: Unload TTS models after this long without generating. The next generation reloads the model (a few seconds).

exclusive.title: One voice engine at a time
exclusive.description: Unload other TTS engines before loading a new one, so switching engines never overflows VRAM. Recommended for 8 GB cards.

refinePrompt.title: Custom prompt for the LLM
refinePrompt.description: Your own instructions for the model that cleans up transcripts.
refinePrompt.replaceWarning: Replace mode ignores the toggles above and the built-in examples — the model only sees your prompt.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.description: Turn a .txt or .csv file into many audio files at once — download them separately or merged into one, with matching subtitles.

input.title: 1. Text
input.hint: CSV: a "text" column (or the first column) and an optional "filename" column. TXT: paragraphs separated by a blank line, or one line per item.
input.empty: No text found in that file

progress.none: No batches yet. Load a file on the left to start.

download.title: 3. Download
download.failedNote: Failed items are skipped. Use Retry in History, then download again.
